DIAGNOSIS READY: Oppositional Defiant Disorder (ODD). 

The history of a 9-year-old male exhibiting defiance ("You're not the boss of me"), refusal to participate in directed activities, and specifically refusing gym class despite enjoying unstructured physical play during recess, strongly suggests a pattern of negativism and defiance toward authority figures while maintaining positive peer relationships.
